subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's operation-aware delivery resolver and QQBot READY/RESUMED pending-delivery drain as the compatibility-safe fix for the linked QQBot reconnect message-loss bug?
rationale: The patch looks technically coherent and proven, but it changes central delivery resolution and reconnect replay behavior where green CI cannot fully prove upgrade safety for all plugins.

options.title: Accept With Owner Signoff
options.body: Merge after the outbound/QQBot owner confirms the resolver selection rules and reconnect drain semantics are the intended upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller variant that limits resolver changes or drain scope if maintainers want less central compatibility impact.

options.title: Pause For Alternate Design
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of a different owner-designed channel lifecycle fix if replay-on-reconnect is not the desired contract.

recommendation.title: Accept With Owner Signoff
recommendation.body: Merge after the outbound/QQBot owner confirms the resolver selection rules and reconnect drain semantics are the intended upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The highest-risk decision is in the central outbound resolver path, where vincentkoc has recent focused history.
